packets.claim: Existing ClayCode G9 semantics may lower into one compiler-internal Causal Transition Kernel carrying epoch, delta, typed role/relation, provenance, effect/capability/flow, measurement/intervention, cost and receipts without changing surface semantics.
packets.falsifier: Unified CTK adds overhead/complexity without reducing duplicate validators/lowerings or fails semantic parity.
packets.next_test: Implement minimal Delta+EffectIntent+Measurement lowering in unified vs separate IR paths.

packets.claim: In a 200-seed noisy recurrent tracking toy model, truthful ordered re-entry reduced mean MSE to 0.1044 vs 0.3005 for temporally shuffled re-entry and 0.3317 for no re-entry.
packets.falsifier: Truthful/shuffled/no-reentry become equivalent or shuffled performs as well under target replay.
packets.next_test: H1 truthful vs shuffled vs none with same model output/seeds.

packets.claim: Unlabeled pairwise clique reduction cannot preserve role-labelled ternary identity: six role assignments over the same three members collapse to one reduction, losing log2(6)=2.585 bits of role identity.
packets.verification_requirement: Compare typed role-labelled pairwise state-machine reduction vs native n-ary relation
packets.falsifier: A simpler typed pairwise encoding preserves all required replay/intervention semantics with lower cost.

packets.claim: Incremental dependency closure is conditionally efficient, not universally: synthetic DAG mean touched fraction rose from 0.094 at mean parent count 1 to 0.923 at mean parent count 8.
packets.falsifier: Real Delta/ViewDelta workloads remain cheaper than batch even at dense closure after overhead.
packets.next_test: Measure adaptive incremental/batch crossover on real ClayGraph/UDB queries.

packets.claim: Individually valid secret-read and public-send capabilities can compose into a forbidden information flow; capability validity alone therefore does not imply composition safety.
packets.falsifier: Fine-grained capability architecture can prove all realistic protected flows safe without additional flow labels while preserving utility.
packets.next_test: Capability-only vs capability+IFC vs capability+IFC+runtime sink revalidation.

packets.claim: Atomic old-or-new semantic epoch publication eliminated mixed two-field reads in a toy interleaving model where naive two-step visibility produced ~33.4% invariant-violating snapshots.
packets.falsifier: Real epoch publication cost/coordination exceeds benefit or legitimate asynchronous semantics cannot be represented.

packets.claim: Primary prior work supports separating effect visibility, resource authority and information-flow confinement: effect types, capability systems and IFC solve overlapping but non-identical problems; none alone validates Clay Safe-Effect Geometry.
packets.falsifier: A simpler single-layer mechanism matches protection and utility across the required workload/threat model.

packets.claim: The highest-information next BASE artifact is a cross-branch executable semantic conformance suite with one minimal witness per registered scientific branch; it should precede additional surface-language redesign.
packets.verification_requirement: Attempt suite construction against current G9
packets.falsifier: Witnesses cannot be specified without unresolved surface semantics or suite provides no discriminatory compiler feedback.
packets.next_test: Parser -> canonical IR -> type/effect/flow -> evaluator/lowering witness suite.
